title: Barcelona by Tuk Tuk
text:
We wanted an original means of transportation, and we can say that it was. By having chosen the Tuk Tuk, we were able to enjoy every moment. The beautiful weather and Danny made our visit to Barcelona unforgettable. It was our first visit to this city and frankly we could not have expected better. Danny, as a true connoisseur, took the time to stop in front of each monument and present it in his own way.
Thank you very much Danny, it was relaxing and pleasant.
